name: Adobe Express
summary: Adobe's simple online design app for social posts, flyers and quick edits, with templates and Firefly features.
strengths: templates for posts, flyers and short videos
connects to Adobe's other apps and AI tools
watchOutFor: Some templates and features are paid.
Check the licence for stock content.

name: Adobe Firefly
summary: Adobe's AI image generator, also built into Adobe apps such as Photoshop and Express.
watchOutFor: Generation credits are limited on free use.
Check the licence terms for your kind of use.

name: Adobe Podcast
summary: Adobe's web tool for cleaning up speech recordings, removing noise and echo, and editing audio like text.
strengths: Enhance Speech cleans up voice recordings
watchOutFor: Free use has limits on length and number of files. Check the current rules.
Over-processing can make voices sound artificial.

name: Adobe Premiere Pro
summary: A professional timeline-based video editor from Adobe.
strengths: a professional editor used widely in the industry
close links with other Adobe apps
watchOutFor: It is a subscription product, with a trial rather than a free plan.
Powerful but takes time to learn.

name: AIVA
summary: An AI composer that creates instrumental music in many styles, aimed at film, games and background tracks.
watchOutFor: Check what each plan allows for commercial use.
Instrumental only. No vocals.

name: Audacity
summary: A free, open-source program for recording and editing audio.
strengths: free recording and clean-up of audio
watchOutFor: It is not an AI voice tool. It records and edits sound only.
The interface takes time to learn.

name: BandLab
summary: A free online and mobile music studio for recording, mixing and sharing songs, with loops and AI helpers.
strengths: a full recording studio in the browser and phone
a library of loops and sounds
watchOutFor: Browser and phone performance varies with your device.
Check the licence terms for loops you publish.

name: Beatoven.ai
summary: An AI music tool, founded in India, that makes background music for videos and podcasts from mood and genre.
strengths: background music matched to a mood
watchOutFor: Check the licence on your plan for commercial use.
Instrumental tracks only.

name: Buffer
summary: A simple tool for planning and scheduling posts across social networks, with basic analytics.
watchOutFor: Free use limits channels and scheduled posts. Check the current rules.
Each network has its own rules for scheduling tools.

name: Camtasia
summary: A screen recorder with a built-in editor for polished tutorials and training videos.
strengths: record and edit in one program
watchOutFor: A paid product, with a trial listed on the official page.
Aimed at tutorial makers more than quick captures.

name: CapCut
summary: A video editor for phones and computers with templates, captions and effects.
strengths: quick edits with templates and automatic captions
watchOutFor: Check that it is available where you live. Some countries restrict it.
Some effects and exports may need a paid plan.

name: Clipchamp
summary: A simple video editor from Microsoft that runs in the browser and on Windows.
strengths: a plain timeline that is easy to learn
nothing to install when used in the browser
watchOutFor: It has fewer advanced features than professional editors.
Export quality options may depend on your plan.

name: ComfyUI
summary: An open-source node-based program for running image and video models on your own computer, with full control over each step.
strengths: total control over how an image is made
watchOutFor: It has a steep learning curve and needs a strong graphics card.
Check the licence of each model you load.

name: DaVinci Resolve
summary: A professional video editing and colour-grading program with a free version.
strengths: a free version for desktop computers
watchOutFor: It needs a fairly powerful computer.
The learning curve is steep for a first video.

name: Descript
summary: An editor that turns speech into text so you can edit audio and video by editing the transcript.
strengths: editing talk-based video by editing the transcript
watchOutFor: Check the transcript for errors before you rely on it.
Free plans limit transcription and exports.

name: ElevenLabs
summary: An AI voice tool that turns text into natural-sounding speech in many voices and languages.
watchOutFor: Clone only voices you have permission to use.
Check the licence if you publish the audio commercially.

name: FFmpeg
summary: A free command-line toolkit for converting, trimming and processing video and audio files.
strengths: scriptable for many files at once
watchOutFor: It is a command-line tool with no window.
Copy commands only from sources you trust.

name: Final Cut Pro
summary: Apple's professional video editor for Mac, known for fast editing on Apple hardware.
watchOutFor: Mac only.
A paid app, with a trial period listed on the official page.

name: FLUX models
summary: Image models from Black Forest Labs, with some versions open for you to run yourself and others used through its service.
strengths: some open-weight versions run on your own computer
watchOutFor: Running them yourself needs a strong graphics card.
Licences differ by version. Check before commercial use.

name: GarageBand
summary: Apple's free music and podcast studio for Mac, iPhone and iPad.
watchOutFor: Apple devices only.
Fewer controls than professional audio programs.

name: GIMP
summary: A free, open-source photo and image editor for retouching, cut-outs and compositing.
strengths: a free alternative to paid photo editors
watchOutFor: The interface takes time to learn.
It does not open every Photoshop feature one-to-one.

name: HeyGen
summary: An AI video tool that makes presenter-style videos from a script, with a digital avatar and voice.
strengths: a presenter video from a written script
watchOutFor: Use only faces and voices you have permission to use.
Viewers may find avatar videos less personal.

name: Hootsuite
summary: A long-running social media management platform for scheduling, monitoring and reporting, aimed at teams.
watchOutFor: More than a single creator needs.
Check the plan options on the official page.

name: Ideogram
summary: An AI image generator that is known for putting readable text inside images, such as posters and logos.
strengths: handles text inside images better than many tools
simple prompt box with style options
watchOutFor: Check the licence before using images commercially.
Free limits and features change often. Check the official page.

name: iMovie
summary: Apple's free, simple video editor for Mac, iPhone and iPad.
strengths: simple and free on Apple devices
good for quick edits and trailers
watchOutFor: Apple devices only.
Fewer controls than professional editors.

name: InShot
summary: A phone video and photo editor that is widely used for quick social media edits.
strengths: easy trimming, music and captions on a phone
watchOutFor: Free use includes ads and may add a watermark.
Some features are paid.

name: InVideo AI
summary: A video maker that builds a draft video with stock clips, voice-over and captions from a text brief.
strengths: a first draft from a text prompt
edit the result with text commands
watchOutFor: Drafts still need your editing for accuracy and tone.
Free exports may carry a watermark. Check the current rules.

name: Kapwing
summary: An online editor for videos, subtitles and memes that works well for team and social content.
strengths: subtitles and resizing for social formats
watchOutFor: Free exports may carry a watermark. Check the current rules.
Long videos can be slow in a browser.

name: Kdenlive
summary: A free, open-source video editor with multiple tracks, effects and titles for Windows, macOS and Linux.
watchOutFor: Less polished than paid editors.
Large projects need a reasonably powerful computer.

name: Kling AI
summary: An AI video generator from Kuaishou that makes clips from text and images.
watchOutFor: Free limits and features change often. Check the official page.
The company is based in China. Check the privacy policy before uploading private images.

name: Krisp
summary: An app that removes background noise from calls and can also record, transcribe and summarise meetings.
strengths: meeting notes without a bot joining
watchOutFor: Free use is limited. Check what the plans allow.
Tell people when you record a call.

name: Later
summary: A visual planner for scheduling Instagram, TikTok and other social posts, with a drag-and-drop calendar.
strengths: built for image- and video-led platforms
watchOutFor: Free use limits posts. Check the current rules.
Each network has its own rules for scheduling tools.

name: Leonardo.Ai
summary: An AI image generator with style presets and editing tools for game art, product shots and illustrations.
strengths: many style presets and fine-tuned models
watchOutFor: Free use is limited by daily credits. Check the current rules.
Check the licence before using images commercially.

name: Loom
summary: A quick screen and camera recorder that gives you a link to share straight after recording.
strengths: record and share a link in seconds
watchOutFor: Free recording length and video count are limited. Check the current rules.
Videos are stored in Loom's cloud.

name: Luma
summary: An AI video and image creation platform from Luma AI, which began with the Dream Machine video generator.
strengths: turning a still image into a moving clip
watchOutFor: Clips are short and credits are limited.
Faces and hands can look wrong.

name: Midjourney
summary: An AI image generator known for artistic, stylised pictures made from text prompts.
watchOutFor: Check the terms before using images commercially.
Text inside images is often wrong.

name: Murf AI
summary: A text-to-speech studio for voice-overs, with many voices and a simple timeline for syncing to slides or video.
strengths: a simple editor for timing voice-overs
watchOutFor: Free use is limited. Check what the plans allow.
Check pronunciation of names and technical terms.

name: OBS Studio
summary: Free, open-source software for recording your screen and live streaming, with scenes and sources.
strengths: records and streams with many sources
watchOutFor: More controls than a beginner needs.
Download it only from the official site.

name: OpusClip
summary: A tool that cuts long videos into short clips for social platforms, with captions added automatically.
strengths: turns a long video into several short clips
watchOutFor: Check each clip. The cut points can miss the point.
Free use is limited. Check the current rules.

name: Photopea
summary: A Photoshop-like image editor that runs in the browser and opens PSD, XCF and other layered files.
strengths: no install, runs in the browser
opens many file types, including PSD
watchOutFor: Free use shows ads. Check what the paid plan changes.
Large files can be slow in a browser.

name: Photoroom
summary: An app for removing backgrounds and making clean product photos, in the browser and on phones.
strengths: quick background removal and product shots
watchOutFor: Free exports may carry a watermark. Check the current rules.
Free limits and features change often. Check the official page.

name: Runway
summary: An AI video tool that creates and edits short clips from text, images or existing video.
strengths: generating short clips from a description
AI tools for changing existing footage
watchOutFor: Clip length and credits are limited. Check before planning a long video.
Results vary a lot between tries.

name: Sora
summary: OpenAI's video generator, which makes short clips from text prompts and images.
strengths: short clips from a text description
works from images as well as text
watchOutFor: Access, limits and regions change. Check the official page.
Check the rules on likeness and commercial use.

name: Soundraw
summary: A music generator for background tracks where you choose mood, length and genre and then adjust parts.
strengths: adjust a track to fit your video
watchOutFor: Check the licence on your plan for commercial use.
Instrumental tracks only.

name: Speechify
summary: A text-to-speech app that reads articles, PDFs and documents aloud, popular for studying and accessibility.
strengths: reads PDFs and web pages aloud
watchOutFor: Many voices and features are paid.
Check the current free limits.

name: Stable Diffusion
summary: A family of open image-generation models you can run on your own computer or through other apps.
watchOutFor: You need a capable computer and some setup.
Each model has its own licence. Read it before commercial use.

name: Suno
summary: An AI music generator that makes full songs with vocals from a text description or your own lyrics.
strengths: complete songs from a short prompt
you can write your own lyrics
watchOutFor: Check the licence terms for what you may do with songs on each plan.
Results vary. Plan for several tries.

name: Synthesia
summary: A tool that makes presenter-style videos from a script using AI avatars and voices.
watchOutFor: Free use is limited. Check what the plans allow.
Make clear to viewers when an avatar is used.

name: Udio
summary: An AI music generator that creates songs from text prompts, with tools to extend and remix them.
watchOutFor: Rules on downloads and licensing have changed. Check the current terms.
Results vary. Plan for several tries.

name: VEED
summary: An online video editor with automatic subtitles, screen recording and simple AI helpers.
strengths: editing and recording in the browser
watchOutFor: Free exports may carry a watermark. Check the current rules.
Check subtitle accuracy, especially names.

name: VN Video Editor
summary: A free-to-start video editor for phones and computers that is popular for short social videos.
strengths: templates and effects for short videos
watchOutFor: Check what is limited on the free version.
Some features are paid.
